verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a government tax-filing portal. Users do not author automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back their own automations is outside this product category. The MeinELSTER+ automatic return creation is a built-in pre-fill feature, not a user-defined automation, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
